text:
arjun_mkt: Quick post-event plan for Tuesday's "Inference at Scale" session. Need final confirmation on replay timing, clip owners, lead-splitting rules, and legal checks. Can owners confirm?

lina_ops: I'll confirm recordings. Plan: internal MP4 + raw SRT posted to S3 at T+2h: s3://redwood-marketing/replays/2026-07-14/{event-id}/. Public replay page at T+24h after PII scrub. Retention: NA=90d, EMEA=30d.

oliver_growth: Lead split rules: live attendees -> hubspot list "inference_live_7_14"; replay viewers -> "inference_replay_7_14". If product_interest=core-inference -> AE alert within 12h. If company_size>1000 -> tag enterprise and escalate immediately. We'll also mark source by utm: utm_campaign=inference_jul.

maya_social: Clips: generate top 3 clips automatically (intro, benchmark, Q&A). I'll own social highlights + 1-minute hero clip. File path for clips: s3://redwood-marketing/replays/2026-07-14/clips/. Also draft two social posts: one for replay drop, one for clips release.

sam_legal: Legal: need explicit consent checkbox for sharing recording with partners. Also require PII QA before public posting. I'll run quick review after Lina's scrub.

lina_ops: PII scrub workflow: run transcript through pii-scrub v1.4, flag items, manual review (sam_legal + arjun_mkt). Then generate public SRT with redactions.

zoom-bot: Zoom meeting completed. Cloud recording processed. Master recording URL: https://zoom.us/rec/share/ABC123. Transcript available.

arjun_mkt: Who monitors chat during the event and who confirms recording link T+1h?

maya_social: I monitored chat and clipped two live Q&A moments. @lina_ops, please confirm the official recording link in #marketing within 60m.

lina_ops: Will confirm link within 45m and start upload. Also setting watermarking for EMEA replays (email watermark).

oliver_growth: Follow-up sequencing: 0-6h: internal recap + hot leads to AE. 6-48h: nurture email to all registrants (replay + 3 clips + 1-pager). 48-96h: segmented outreach based on engagement signals (opens, clip clicks).

arjun_mkt: Email draft subjects: A) "Replay: Inference at Scale + Clips" B) "Thanks — highlights and replay from today" Which do we send to registrants vs attendees?

maya_social: Send A to registrants, B as short thank-you to live attendees. We'll A/B test CTA placement.

sam_legal: Confirmed legal checkpoint: partner opt-in mapping exists and will not be auto-shared unless opt-in=true. Also confirm retention policy settings in Zoom admin.

lina_ops: All set in Zoom admin. I'll post the S3 internal link and tag owners once upload completes.

arjun_mkt: Great work. Owners recap: @maya_social (clips + social), @lina_ops (recording + upload + PII scrub start), @oliver_growth (lead split + nurture), @sam_legal (PII signoff). Closing this thread ":white_check_mark:"
